plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and holding a larger cash buffer, aiming for low drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to low single digits.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets about 2.5% monthly return by blending growth with risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name, keeping a moderate cash buffer.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to 6% each.
